prompts.name: loading-impeller
prompts.prompt: Create a NEW original story illustration, exact wide2:1. Attached images are identity/style references ONLY, not scenes to copy. Same black-and-white Macintosh adventure/woodcut style, rounded work submarine with compact conning tower, three clean portholes, tail fins and propeller. Real three-dimensional depth: cropped near foreground, overlapping forms, clear near/middle/distant scale, oblique cylindrical surfaces and perspective. Strong solid black shadow masses and broad clean white lit planes, restrained25/50percent ordered surface shading on curved sidewalls only. Chunky recognizable forms for128x64pixels. No people, silhouettes, hands, lettering, labels, UI, captions, borders, watermarks or all-overgrain. Scene: Cormorant industrial loading berth. A NEW CLEAN UNBROKEN three-bladed impeller, visibly a thick circular hub with three broad curved vanes, is secured upright in a sturdy padded cargo cradle on the deck of the familiar small worksub in midground. Wide restraining straps around the cradle, no filter boxes. A large cropped gantry beam and lowered hook above the cargo imply recent loading, no workers. Camera looks low and obliquely along a near dock edge toward the sub and a modest lit industrial loading bay farther behind. Make the new impeller and secured cargo the focal shape, large enough to read at128x64; no broken blade. Quiet preparation for delivery to Benthos. Strong volume and clear silhouette.

prompts.name: water-restored
prompts.prompt: Create a NEW original story illustration, exact wide2:1. Attached images are identity/style references ONLY, not scenes to copy. Same black-and-white Macintosh adventure/woodcut style, rounded work submarine with compact conning tower, three clean portholes, tail fins and propeller. Real three-dimensional depth: cropped near foreground, overlapping forms, clear near/middle/distant scale, oblique cylindrical surfaces and perspective. Strong solid black shadow masses and broad clean white lit planes, restrained25/50percent ordered surface shading on curved sidewalls only. Chunky recognizable forms for128x64pixels. No people, silhouettes, hands, lettering, labels, UI, captions, borders, watermarks or all-overgrain. Scene: water returns to the Benthos grow room after pump restoration. NEW oblique low angle with near right foreground a cropped thick supply pipe and open valve; a short glass junction shows a few LARGE clean bubbles flowing into a hero cylindrical hydroponic tank in midground left. Its bright waterline, submerged white branching roots and broad healthy leafy food crop are clearly readable. A second smaller tank recedes behind it along floor pipes toward a lit back doorway. Overhead service lamps newly ON give broad white pools of light and strong contact shadows. Clear connected returning water circuit, healthy crops and newly lit infrastructure, no written SERVICE labels. Avoid too many thin roots, prioritize waterline/pipe/tank volume and living leaves.

referenceRoles: Prior illustrations are work-sub identity, hydroponic materials and heavy machinery style references; these are new scenes, not replacements.

nativeRendering.method: Balanced v3 integer source-cell RGB area average. Outside threshold +/-40 solid threshold result. Within:25% white below threshold-13;50% below threshold+13;75% otherwise. Ordered2x2 [[0,2],[3,1]].
nativeRendering.rendererRuntime: Node.js built-ins; run from repository root
